# Tru8 Evidence Research API

> Structured evidence research for AI agents. Submit a claim or URL, get back
> source-traced evidence organized by tier and type, with element decomposition
> and relationship mapping.

## API Base

https://api.tru8.app

## Authentication

Header: X-API-Key: <your_key>
Keys: POST /api/v1/api-keys (requires JWT)
Docs: https://tru8.app/developers

## Core Workflow

### Synchronous (recommended for agents)
POST /api/v1/checks/run — blocks until complete, returns full result with analytics.
  Set HTTP timeout >= 180s. URLs auto-select claims (up to 5, highest-ranked).
  Returns 504 on timeout, 502 on pipeline error, 402 on credit limit.

### Streaming (for dashboards)
POST /api/v1/checks/stream — SSE progress stream
GET /api/v1/checks/{id} — retrieve completed result
GET /api/v1/checks/{id}?computed=true — result with pre-computed analytics

## Pipeline

Deep Research (typically 60-120s): extract claims → retrieve evidence from multiple
independent sources → decompose each claim into verifiable elements → map evidence
to elements with relationship labels. Includes coverage recovery for low-coverage claims.

## Evidence Model

Sources classified on two axes:
- Tier: primary (original data/measurements) | reporting (news coverage) | commentary (opinion/analysis)
- Type: data | official | news | analysis | opinion | academic

Each claim is decomposed into verifiable elements. Evidence is mapped to elements
with relationship labels: supports | challenges | context.

Element states (derived mechanically, no editorial judgment):
- supported — preponderance of evidence supports this element
- disputed — conflicting evidence exists
- unresolved — insufficient evidence to determine

## Computed Analytics (?computed=true)

Adds a _computed block: summary (element state counts, coverage gaps),
evidenceByTier, evidenceByType, heatmap (tier×type matrix), corroboration
(evidence groups citing same facts), diagnosticValues (per-evidence
analytical scores), timeline (date range, gaps), perClaim (dispositions).

## MCP Server

Package: tru8-mcp — pip install tru8-mcp (or uvx tru8-mcp)
Run: tru8-mcp (or python -m tru8_mcp)
Env: TRU8_API_KEY (required), TRU8_API_URL (optional)

Tools:
- tru8_check(text) — evidence research, returns result with analytics
- tru8_get_result(check_id) — retrieve result with computed analytics
- tru8_get_result_raw(check_id) — retrieve result without computed analytics

## Rate Limits

- General: 60 req/min
- Check creation: 10 req/min

## OpenAPI

- Swagger: https://api.tru8.app/api/docs
- ReDoc: https://api.tru8.app/api/redoc
